title: ORAN FH CUS: Add a tap to tshark

notes.body: Not sure what the pipeline failure has to do with this change..

It's due to https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2332805. Our containers update each Sunday, and Fedora's mingw64 Qt packages are still broken. I reverted our repository tag to an earlier build, so things should work again.
